issue_context.title: Switch image in gRPC probe tests to agnhost
issue_context.body:
- Tests in `test/e2e/common/node/container_probe.go` are using `etcd` image for gRPC probe tests:
  - should not be restarted with a GRPC liveness probe
  - should be restarted with a GRPC liveness probe

We should use `agnhost` image for these tests as it is much smaller size.

/sig node
/kind cleanup
/priority important-soon
/area tests
/help-wanted
/good-first-issue

KEP: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/2727
